title: PrivateEye
description: PrivateEye instantly logs all private message conversations to Discord using real-time webhooks.
body:
**PrivateEye 👁️**
### Keep your server safe by logging private conversations directly to Discord.

**PrivateEye** is a lightweight, high-performance plugin designed for server administrators who want to monitor private messages (DMs) without interfering with the player experience. It captures vanilla commands and those from popular plugins (like EssentialsX) and sends them to a Discord channel via Webhooks.

**✨ Features**
**Discord Integration:** View /msg, /tell, and /whisper conversations in real-time on your Discord server.

**- Universal Tracking:** Works with vanilla Minecraft and most chat plugins.

**- Smart Reply System:** Automatically detects and logs /r (reply) commands by remembering the last conversation.

**- Beautiful Embeds:** Messages are sent as clean Discord embeds including the sender's head (skin) and custom colors.

**- Zero Interference:** The plugin does not block or change how chat works for players; it only logs it.

**- Fully Configurable:** Easily change the Webhook URL, tracked commands, and bot appearance in the config.yml.

**⚙️ Configuration**
Everything is handled in a simple config file:

**1.** Paste your Discord Webhook URL.

 **2.** Choose which commands you want to track.

 **3.** Set your preferred bot name and sidebar color.



**config.yml**

```
# ==========================================
# PrivateEye Configuration
# ==========================================

discord:
  # Paste your Discord Webhook URL here
  webhook-url: "INSERT_WEBHOOK_HERE"

settings:
  # The name that appears as the sender in Discord
  webhook-bot-name: "PrivateEye Spy"

  # Sidebar color for Discord messages (Hex format)
  embed-color: "#e67e22"

  # List of commands that follow the format: /cmd <player> <message>
  # This detects vanilla and most plugin commands (EssentialsX, CMI, etc.)
  tracked-commands:
    - msg
    - tell
    - w
    - whisper
    - m
    - t
    - pm
    - message
    - dm

# Note: /r and /reply are automatically handled by the plugin's memory.
```
